decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1, dated 9/11/12, received 02/01/13; "Site Plan", undated, received 02/01/13; "Easy 200/400/600 Pedestrian Gate Closer", dated January 2012, received 08/03/13) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Each of the two proposed gates on the secure bike shelter hereby approved shall be fitted with the self closing mechanism detailed in the document entitled "Easy 200/400/600 Pedestrian Gate Closer", dated January 2012, received 08/03/13, before the structure is used. If the mechanisms fail they will be replaced appropriately.
description: Erection of a 10 bike secure shelter for staff use
